whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Highway Junction,

I noticed your restaurant has amazing 4.0★ reviews with over 2,300 happy diners in Saguna More, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital food menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/highwayjunction

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Highway Junction, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Highway Junction Saguna More Danapur) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table reservation, a digital food menu, and directions for diners searching around Saguna More and Mustafapur. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items, photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
